task.title: Correlate BIOS policy and worker application
task.question: Capture the active policy, current/requested state, correctly indexed requests/readers, callback registration and parent/child observations together.
task.done_when: Capture the active policy, current/requested state, correctly indexed requests/readers, callback registration and parent/child observations together. Independent reviewer accepts the scoped evidence.

stage.title: Video domain + clocks
stage.next_evidence: Capture active BIOS clock policy, worker gate words and parent/child observations; table roles and ordered protocol are recovered.

claims.title: Row-6 children 23/22 are VCLK/DCLK
claims.scope: Independent metrics ABI link identifies software clock roles, not measured clocks.

claims.title: Row-6 parent/child protocols and cache bypasses are recovered
claims.scope: Ordered polls, not required edges; f714 cache can bypass. Physical bit meanings open.

claims.title: SSIP is preferred policy-copy inference; runtime semantics open
claims.scope: SSIP aligns all twenty worker slots and a second initializer; CONST.S supports the option. Index19 feeds child12/parent1. Shared opcode prevents raw-bit selection; runtime remains unvalidated.

claims.title: SMU power already up and secure/LMA bypass paths are reported
claims.scope: One dom6 sample is insufficient for physical power. Master/path-specific filter behavior remains unvalidated.

claims.title: Upstream reports SMU prerequisite rejection and harvest/fuse leads
claims.scope: Messages 2A/2B reportedly return FD through the documented SMN mailbox. Exact handler identity, prerequisite cause, and fuse interpretation require validation; mailbox aliasing is unresolved.

claims.title: Worker gate and selector conventions constrain clock application
claims.scope: Feature13 installs callback24; equal current/requested states skip application. Setter does not advance the gate; setter/read selectors differ by one and readers return caches.

claims.title: Refined Ghidra export recovers additional functions and calls
claims.scope: 1290 -> 1297 functions; halt_baddata-affected functions 97 -> 7; 158 added direct edges among shared entries. Experimental decoding and remaining truncations are recorded.

dependencies.title: Pin down one reproducible board baseline
dependencies.question: Which BIOS, kernel, candidate and startup route produce the failure?
dependencies.done_when: Attach BIOS/candidate hashes, exact kernel/patches, firmware filename, admission and harvest trace, full timestamped log.

instructions: Read AGENTS.md and VERIFICATION.md. Sync the repository and check issues before claiming. Workers submit evidence; a different human principal must reproduce and approve. Preserve snapshot SHA-256 in submissions.
